VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: WIT

The reviewer note raises a critical concern about nondeterministic behavior when ties exist for the largest leg—the residual allocation would be inconsistent across runs. While the agent reports all 19 tests passing, the self-report alone cannot validate that the implementation handles tie-breaking deterministically or that the test suite adequately covers this edge case. The witness observation of a potential flaw in the core logic (nondeterministic residual allocation) is sufficient to indicate the acceptance criteria may not be truly satisfied, since "rounding drift is eliminated" implies consistent, deterministic behavior.
